game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Definitive Edition
platform: Nintendo Switch 2 (backward compat of Switch version; no native edition found)

findings.name: Console achievement/trophy list (PS/Xbox)
findings.detail: PS: 34 trophies (1 Plat Kingpin, 5 Gold, 9 Silver, 19 Bronze). Xbox: 33 achievements, 1000G. gta.wiki: 33 gameplay + 43 Social Club entries, 9 Social Club-exclusive. gtabase lists 43 entries (Plat + 42). Counts disagree between sources.

findings.name: Gtabase list (includes Social Club-only likely)
findings.detail: Born in the 80's (listen to every radio station), Running Rampant (Vigilante lvl 12), Iron-y, Not my First Time, One is Better Than Two (30s wheelie), Point A to Point B (25 taxi fares), High Quality H2O (10 fires), Pie Guy (10 pizzas), Bull in a China Shop ($1,000,000 property damage), Vice City Mogul (own 10 properties), Salutations My Little Friend, Catch Me if You Can (6 stars), Somebody Call the Wambulance? (Paramedic lvl 12), Greasy Palms (bribe), Just Like the Real Thing (RC Bandit race), Keepie-Uppy Okie Dokie (score 5), Gun for Hire (all assassinations), I'm Famous! (Stuff of Legends), Don't Need Roads (Deluxo max speed), Daredevil (36 jumps), Legal Counsel (Riot), Life of the Party (All Hands on Deck!), South American Connection (Supply & Demand), Big Heat from Little Havana (Trojan Voodoo), Chauffeur (Publicity Tour), Tommy Two-Wheels (Hog Tied), Grand Theft Auto (all Sunshine Autos wanted vehicles), Bloodstained Hands (Butcher), Take the Cannoli (Godfather), Mischief Managed (Keep Your Friends Close...), Chopper'd Up (Demolition Man), City Sleuth (100 packages), Done it All (100%), Put 'Em Up (15 stores), Offender (50 wanted starts), Retro Lewk (wear every outfit), Scouring the City! (50 packages), Break it Up ($500,000 damage), Target Practice (50 headshots), Prime Real Estate (all properties), Vice Vice Baby (Cherry Popper dealer subgame), Baked Distractions (hijack tank without alerting army, Sir Yes Sir!). Which of these are on PS vs only Social Club is NOT confirmed (powerpyx PS list of 34 does not include Baked Distractions per a commenter).
findings.trackable: Many map to Stats screen values

findings.name: Four mission-specific trophies
findings.detail: Iron-y (kill property developer with golf club, Four Iron), Not my First Time (G-Spotlight without falling from rooftops), Salutations My Little Friend (kill Diaz with M4 in Rub Out), Chopper'd Up (kill all hostile NPCs in Demolition Man with RC chopper blades). Mission ends instantly on target death. Replayable via mission replay normally in GTA games (replay availability not confirmed here).

findings.name: 100% completion items are not missable
findings.detail: Both guides state nothing needed for 100% is missable; all can be done after credits.

findings.name: 100% completion components
findings.detail: 20 story missions, 20 asset missions across 10 properties + 4 Sunshine Autos import lists + Pole Position Club $300 dance room, 13 gang missions, 5 assassinations, 5 vehicle missions (Firefighter/Paramedic/Vigilante/Pizza Boy level 10, 100 taxi fares), 4 off-road, 3 RC, 6 street races, 3 stadium events, 4 chopper checkpoints, 35 rampages, 36 unique jumps, 100 hidden packages, rifle range 45+, all 7 safehouses, all 15 stores robbed. (Original-game Rockstar page lists different counts, e.g. 21 story missions.)

findings.name: Purchasable assets and income
findings.detail: Per gtabase (price / income per day): Viceport Boatyard $10,000 / $2,000; Cherry Popper Ice Cream Factory $20,000 / $3,000; Pole Position Club $30,000 / $4,000; Kaufman Cabs $40,000 / $5,000; Sunshine Autos $50,000 / $1,500-9,000; InterGlobal Studios $60,000 / $7,000; Print Works $70,000 / $8,000; Malibu Club $120,000 / $10,000. Vercetti Estate free after Rub Out ($5,000/day listed). Phil's Place not purchasable (after The Job). Assets available after Shakedown. 8 purchasable assets = $400,000. Income per day figures are single-source and unverified; revenue starts once the asset's missions are done and is collected at the property.
findings.trackable: Property purchases tracked toward completion; Mogul/Prime Real Estate need own-count

findings.name: Safehouses
findings.detail: Gtabase: 9 total, 7 purchasable ($41,500 total): Ocean View Hotel (free), Vercetti Estate (free), 3321 Vice Point $2,500, Links View Apartment $6,000, El Swanko Casa $8,000, 1102 Washington Street $3,000, Ocean Heights Apartment $7,000, Skumole Shack $1,000, Hyman Condo $14,000. Note: that list shows 7 priced entries, consistent with 7 purchasable. 5 on first island, 2 on second (powerpyx). Property count for Vice City Mogul/Prime Real Estate: powerpyx says 17 purchasable properties, gtabase says 18 - listed items sum to 15. UNRESOLVED.

findings.name: Outfits
findings.detail: Frankie outfit unlocked at Vercetti Estate at 100% completion. Total outfit count NOT found. Achievement Retro Lewk (wear every outfit at least once) listed on gtabase only.

findings.name: Hidden packages, rampages, jumps, stores
findings.detail: 100 hidden packages ($100 each, final adds $100,000 -> $110,000 total per one source); 35 rampages; 36 unique stunt jumps; 15 stores robbed.

findings.name: RNG notes
findings.detail: No strongly RNG-gated items found. Bloodring described as 'a little random' due to AI cars. Criminal rating/media attention accumulate from play. Checkpoint Charlie boatyard revenue duplication glitch reported (may be patched).

versionNotes.note: Switch/Switch 2 achievements: NOT confirmed. Rockstar advertised Social Club 'Accomplishments' for the Trilogy; Nintendo has no native achievement system. Console lists are only documented for PlayStation (trophies) and Xbox (achievements). Gta.wiki says 43 Social Club achievements exist, 9 Social Club-exclusive; whether Switch players can earn/see them is unconfirmed.

No native Switch 2 edition or upgrade found. Switch 2 plays the Switch version via backward compatibility per Sportskeeda (secondary source: Rockstar titles absent from Nintendo's issue list). A gtaboom article corrected itself in Oct 2026 saying absence from that list does not by itself confirm full compatibility. A review claims locked 30fps and faster loads on Switch 2 (unverified).
Switch launched with poor performance (frame drops); Nov 2024 patch covered Switch too. Classic Lighting Mode added in Nov 12, 2024 update. Switch has gyro aiming and touch controls.
Switch physical re-release (full game on cartridge, ~ $30 MSRP) in 2025.

Radio: about 15 licensed songs removed vs original (licensing lapses), per gtaintel; other source claims 8. Named: Billie Jean, Wanna Be Startin' Somethin', Bark at the Moon, Running with the Night; artists Kate Bush, Gary Numan, Quiet Riot, ABC, The Buggles, Herbie Hancock, Joe Jackson, Afrika Bambaataa, The Fixx, Aneka, Sigue Sigue Sputnik. Rockstar said lists match the 2014 re-release. Matters for 'Born in the 80's' only if stations affected (stations remain).
Other DE changes: analog steering removed; GTA V-style controls, weapon wheel, GPS, mid-mission checkpoints and instant retry added; Unreal Engine.
Cheats disable trophies/achievements; no difficulty settings; Take the Cannoli requires Patch 1.02+ (threshold lowered to 100,000). Some trophies only pop after pausing.
